# Pre-market brief, Mon Oct 19, 2026 (Research Inc., ~8:25 AM ET)

**Tone: dip-buyers return to AI after Nasdaq's worst week since June; oil eases but stays >$100. Fed in blackout; earnings drive the week.**

1. **Futures:** Nasdaq-100 +1.1%, S&P +0.4%, Dow −0.2% (7:56 AM). Europe red (DAX −1.3%, Stoxx 50 −1.2%); Nikkei −0.6%. ([Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/premarket), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/18/stock-market-today-live-updates.html))
2. **AI/chips bounce:** NVDA +2%; AMD, MU +3%; CRWV +6% after −25% last week; NBIS +3.6% on Truist Buy (PT $355). Chip index ended Fri on its longest losing streak since 2008. ([WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/finance/stocks/stock-futures-rise-as-investors-make-cautious-return-to-risk-cd3b0e6a), [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/intel-jumps-on-jpmorgan-upgrade-datadog-rallies-4957102))
3. **Oil/rates/BTC:** Brent ~$108.4 (−1.4%), WTI ~$100.9 after Trump waived Russia sanctions/tariffs and Iran said its Hormuz reopening offer stands; Iran's tanker-mine claim unconfirmed. 10y ~5.10%, BTC ~$82.4k (+0.5%), gold flat ~$4,166. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-climb-as-investors-return-to-ai-trade-after-selloff-4956195), [Babypips](https://www.babypips.com/analysis/fundies-cheat-sheet-2026-10-19-oil-ai-earnings-yields), box yfinance)
4. **Movers:** INTC +~4% (JPM to Neutral); DDOG +3.6% (Bernstein Outperform, PT $350); AMZN +1% (Morgan Stanley top pick, AWS acceleration); CLF +10–13% (Q3 adj EPS $0.28 vs $0.21 est). ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/19/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-clf-intc-ddog-amzn.html), [StockSetups](https://stocksetups.com/movers/premarket))
5. **Fed:** blackout Oct 17–29; FOMC Oct 28, hike odds ~15–30% depending on source. ([Philly Fed](https://www.philadelphiafed.org/calendar-of-events?tab=blackout-periods), [FHLBNY](https://www.fhlbny.com/w/fi/msd/2026/261016))

**Week ahead:** Today NAHB 10:00. Tue housing starts 8:30; GE/GM/RTX/MMM BMO; NFLX, SpaceX, ISRG, UAL, ALK AMC. Wed T BMO; META, TSLA, IBM, LRCX, TXN, CCI AMC; EIA oil. Thu claims 8:30; PG, AAL BMO. Fri flash PMIs 9:45, UMich 10:00; AXP BMO, XOM. Next: V 10/27, MSFT/GOOGL 10/28, AMZN 10/29. ([Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/economy/this-weeks-economic-calendar), [ClearTape](https://clear-tape.com/earnings), [Earnings Whispers](https://www.earningswhispers.com/calweek/20261019), [Microsoft](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/10/07/microsoft-announces-quarterly-earnings-release-date-69/), [Amazon](https://ir.aboutamazon.com/events/event-details/default.aspx))

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **AMZN**: MS top pick + PT raise on AWS/Bedrock; not in the AI-debt group. Conf: med. Risk: earnings 10/29 inside horizon; AI-capex fears return.
- **DDOG**: Bernstein double-up to Outperform, PT $237→$350. Conf: low. Risk: software/AI rebound fades; largest AI customer concentration.

**Holds, no re-add:** BLK, WMT, XLP, UNH (lesson: +5%/wk names). **Avoid kept:** semis/memory, AI optics, AI-debt infra (one-day bounce isn't a trend; LRCX/TXN Wed), airlines (Brent $108; UAL/ALK Tue), BAC.
